role: Framebuffer readback on the ScreenShotHelper path: reads the RGB pixels with glReadPixels, returns their SHA-1 for the tape's px field and optionally writes a PNG golden frame.
used_by: Oracle.java (px field of every rendered tape row)
make replay (compares px), make script/replay FRAMES=dir (golden PNGs)
tools/pxdiff.c (out/native/pxdiff) consumes the PNGs as golden frames
notes: Client-thread GL readback; keeps a static reused IntBuffer and pixel array. No oracle/src file calls into it (grep of oracle/src for the class name); used_by paths under out/java were listed, not opened.
